hook: At 49, he beat surfers half his age. At the world's deadliest wave.
story: Kelly Slater, a kid from Florida, became the youngest world surfing champion in history at 20. He won five more titles, retired at the top, and came back - to win five more in his thirties. At 39, he became the oldest world champion ever. He holds both ends of the record. Then, in 2022, days before turning 50, he entered the Pipeline Masters - a wave that breaks over shallow reef in Hawaii. The same wave he first conquered at twenty. He won that too.
number: Eleven world titles. Nobody else in the sport's history has more than eight.
closer: Every athlete loses their last fight - against time. He is the only one who didn't.
full_text: At 49, he beat surfers half his age. At the world's deadliest wave. Kelly Slater, a kid from Florida, became the youngest world surfing champion in history at 20. He won five more titles, retired at the top, and came back - to win five more in his thirties. At 39, he became the oldest world champion ever. He holds both ends of the record. Then, in 2022, days before turning 50, he entered the Pipeline Masters - a wave that breaks over shallow reef in Hawaii. The same wave he first conquered at twenty. He won that too. Eleven world titles. Nobody else in the sport's history has more than eight. Every athlete loses their last fight - against time. He is the only one who didn't.
